column1: # .agentic/checks.tsv — project-owned verification checks (authoritative).
# When this file defines at least one check line, ./.agentic/scripts/verify.sh
# and verify.ps1 use ONLY these checks; auto-detection is a bootstrap fallback
# used when this file is absent or defines no checks.
# Format (TAB-separated). Lines starting with `#` are comments. Blank lines are
# ignored. Arguments may contain spaces but NOT tabs.
#   requirement<TAB>check-id<TAB>working-dir<TAB>executable<TAB>args...
#   requirement: `required` (must run; failure fails the run) or `optional`
#                (runs if tooling is available; failure is a warning only).
#   check-id:    short human-readable label shown in output.
#   working-dir: directory (relative to the repository root) to run in; use `.`
#                for the repository root.
#   executable:  command name on PATH, or a path such as ./gradlew.
#   args...:     remaining fields, passed to the executable verbatim.
# Example for a Node.js / pnpm monorepo with an API service:
#   required
#   required
#   required
#   required
#   optional
# Tip: run the installer with --generate-checks to create this file from the
# detected stack, then edit it to match your project's real definition of done.
